title: Robotic Systems Laboratory
weeklyTopics: Armlab Checkpoint 1: arm web interface, control station codebase, camera-to-world transform via tape measure and grid board
Armlab: kinematics and computer vision for a 6-DOF UFACTORY Lite 6 manipulator
Armlab competition: camera calibration through inverse kinematics, block sorting/stacking
Botlab Part 1: assemble the MBot Classic (ROS2, differential drive)
Botlab Part 2: tune feedback/PID controller for motor speed; velocity-command controller
Botlab Part 3: 2D Lidar mapping, SLAM, path planning
Botlab Part 4: OpenCV/AprilTag obstacle and target detection, Potential Field Planner, visual servoing
workloadNotes: Two lab segments (Armlab, Botlab) run as team-based hands-on hardware labs with staged checkpoints; Armlab ends in a competition worth extra credit toward the report grade.
